name: SwitchBot (Woan broadcast)
notes: SwitchBot Color Bulb / LED Strip Light / Plug Mini advertise only manufacturer data with company ID 0x0969 (Woan Technology, SwitchBot's parent) and no device-type byte, so the three cannot be told apart from the broadcast alone (official spec: OpenWonderLabs/SwitchBotAPI-BLE). Protocol-level brand match.
